title: Needs proper multi-account support

title: Insight
body:
I’m a pen paper guy, a list is an instructional reminder all in one place to get the enlisted jobs all done in one movement.

A repeated reminder is only possible if we get the todos on lock screen showing all the list in one screen. And then swipe them away one by one into a “Completed “ list.
E.g buying groceries a b c d and e; put abcde priority-wise in a lock screen list. 
Also if my wife (boss of to-do) could send a list to my device would be wonderful.
My humble regards.
author: Dr Shahid, Peshawar, Pakistan
